items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane suffered a fractured wrist and will miss several weeks after further testing including MRI.
items.implication: Out multiple weeks; opens targets elsewhere in BAL offense.

items.text: AJ Brown high-ankle sprain, no surgery needed, sidelined 4-6 weeks and placed on IR.
items.why: High ankle; more serious end of range possible.
items.implication: Misses multiple weeks; NE WR hierarchy shifts to Doubs etc.

items.text: After meniscus trim, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 vs Chargers.
items.why: Sources; team will evaluate this week.
items.implication: Short absence; Mayer elevated short-term TE1.

items.text: Surprised Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara out: snaps Etienne 53 / Miller 26 / Donaldson 15; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4.
items.why: Even without Kamara, split usage persisted.
items.implication: Etienne lead but not runaway; Miller viable handcuff/flex.
items.opportunity: Etienne still lead opps/routes; monitor if split continues.
items.conflict: Expected fuller takeover vs actual committee.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid finally over PCL; 74% snaps (42/57), 69% routes (22/32 Allen dropbacks). Will move needle when on field.
items.implication: TE1 upside unlocked in BUF offense.
items.opportunity: Strong route participation signals every-down role.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers left early with a hamstring injury that is not considered serious; he would have returned if it was a playoff game and is day-to-day pending MRI.
items.why: Sources say not serious; could have returned in closer game.
items.implication: Monitor practice; likely available Week 2 or limited risk.

items.text: Malik Nabers was a true game-time decision, unsure until ~2 hours before kickoff (family didn't attend), but ruled active and played.
items.why: Decided late; first game post major knee surgery.

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers wherever rostered despite decoy risk after active confirmation.
Alvin Kamara (knee) not expected to play; status impacts Etienne projection.
Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps vs Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks worked off to side early week (groin tweak alleged).
items.why: Clear lead for Hubbard; Brooks limited possibly by tweak.
items.implication: Hubbard preferred starter; Brooks handcuff with upside if healthy.

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season is well under way.
items.implication: Start/upgrade TE with BAL pass volume.

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want as much Bears offense as possible despite Week 1.
items.why: Preseason belief unchanged; Week 1 weirdness or target competition.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason hype with new OC; talked up alongside Loveland.
items.why: Preseason emphasis validated by early performance.
